# Truthworld Full Documentation

> Truthworld is a high-integrity, family-safe video streaming and creator monetization platform featuring automated AI-powered fact checking, localization and dubbing across 70+ languages, 100+ subtitle options, and 100% ad revenue share for creators.

## Architecture & Overview
Truthworld is designed from the ground up for transparency, credibility, and global content reach. The platform incorporates multi-agent AI verification pipelines to fact-check claim statements within video content, generate synchronized dubbing across 70+ languages, and support high-quality subtitles in over 100 languages.

### Key Pillars
1. **Automated AI Fact Checking**: Every video uploaded through Truthworld is ingested through a multi-stage verification pipeline:
   - Video transcription and audio extraction.
   - Atomic factual claim extraction.
   - Web citation search and authoritative cross-checking.
   - Credibility scoring and context overlay annotations displayed directly on the video player.
2. **Global Localization**:
   - Neural voice dubbing in 70+ international and regional languages.
   - Synchronized multilingual subtitles in 100+ languages.
   - Dual and multi-audio track selection within the Truthworld player.
3. **100% Creator Monetization**:
   - Creators retain 100% of their advertising revenue.
   - Built-in transparent ad placement bidding and impression metrics.
4. **Family-Safe Community Integrity**:
   - Automated content safety classifiers preventing harmful, explicit, or misleading content.
   - Community fact-checking and discussion forums.

## Key Sections & URLs
- **Home**: [https://www.truthworld.in/](https://www.truthworld.in/) - Main user landing feed, curated stories, and personalized recommendations.
- **Truthworld Dubbing Studio**: [https://www.truthworld.in/dubbing](https://www.truthworld.in/dubbing) (also at [https://dubbing.truthworld.in/](https://dubbing.truthworld.in/)) - Standalone AI voice dubbing, speaker-matched voice cloning, multilingual subtitle localization, and interactive waveform segment editor.
- **Creator Studio**: [https://www.truthworld.in/studio](https://www.truthworld.in/studio) - Content creator dashboard, video upload pipeline, subtitle/dub editor, and monetization payouts.
- **Advertiser Portal**: [https://www.truthworld.in/advertisements](https://www.truthworld.in/advertisements) - Campaign creation, ad targeting, budget allocation, and analytics.
- **Trending**: [https://www.truthworld.in/trending](https://www.truthworld.in/trending) - Most watched and discussed videos and claims.
- **Browse Topics**: [https://www.truthworld.in/browse](https://www.truthworld.in/browse) - Channel discovery, topic hubs, and category archives.
- **Community**: [https://www.truthworld.in/community](https://www.truthworld.in/community) - User discussions, community posts, and fact-check challenges.
